_source: Verbatim strings extracted from ZIL source (zil/gverbs.zil, zil/1actions.zil). Normalized per project rules: | → \n, bare newline+indent → single space.

roomObjectListing.yourTreasures: Your collection of treasures consists of:

vQuit.prompt: Do you wish to leave the game? (Y is affirmative):

vRestart.prompt: Do you wish to restart? (Y is affirmative):

finish.prompt:
Would you like to restart the game from the beginning, restore a saved game position, or end this session of the game?
(Type RESTART, RESTORE, or QUIT):
>

vAlarm.actorAwake: He's wide awake, or haven't you noticed...

vAnswer.response: Nobody seems to be awaiting your answer.

vAttack.nonActor: I've known strange people, but fighting a %s?
vAttack.bareHands: Trying to attack a %s with your bare hands is suicidal.
vAttack.notAWeapon: Trying to attack the %s with a %s is suicidal.

vBack.response: Sorry, my memory is poor. Please give a direction.

vBlast.response: You can't blast anything by using words.

preBoard.mustBeOnGround: The %s must be on the ground to be boarded.
preBoard.noBoardingTheory: You have a theory on how to board a %s, perhaps?

vBrush.response: If you wish, but heaven only knows why.

vBug.response: Bug? Not in a flawless program like this! (Cough, cough).

vBurn.burningHeldIn: The %s catches fire. Unfortunately, you were in it at the time.
vBurn.burningHeldHolding: The %s catches fire. Unfortunately, you were holding it at the time.
vBurn.consumed: The %s catches fire and is consumed.

vClimbUp.climbingWalls: Climbing the walls is to no avail.
vClimbUp.noClimbableTrees: There are no climbable trees here.

vClose.notOpenable: You must tell me how to do that to a %s.

vCount.blessings: Well, for one, you are playing Zork...

vCurses.actor: Insults of this nature won't help you.
vCurses.general: Such language in a high-class establishment like this!

vCut.inTheBurnable: Not a bright idea, especially since you're in it.
vCut.cutTheBurnable: Your skillful %ssmanship slices the %s into innumerable slivers which blow away.
vCut.prsiNotAWeapon: The "cutting edge" of a %s is hardly adequate.

vDig.shovel: There's no reason to be digging here.
vDig.withTool: Digging with the %s is slow and tedious.

vDisembark.onFeetAgain: You are on your own feet again.
vDisembark.fatalExit: You realize that getting out here would be fatal.

vEat.foodEaten: Thank you very much. It really hit the spot.
vEat.mustHoldContainer: You have to be holding the %s first.
vEat.containerNotOpen: You'll have to open the %s first.
vEat.notEdible: I don't think that the %s would agree with you.

hitSpot.waterDrunk: Thank you very much. I was rather thirsty (from all this talking, probably).

vFill.nothingToFillWith: There's nothing to fill it with.
vFill.nothingToFillWithPre: There is nothing to fill it with.
vFill.dontKnowHow: You may know how to do that, but I don't.

vFind.handsLungs: Within six feet of your head, assuming you haven't left that somewhere.

vFrobozz.response: The FROBOZZ Corporation created, owns, and operates this dungeon.

preGive.notHoldingIt: That's easy for you to say since you don't even have the %s.

vGive.prsiNotActor: You can't give a %s to a %s!

vHello.actorBows: The %s bows his head to you in greeting.
vHello.nonActor: It's a well known fact that only schizophrenics say "Hello" to a %s.

vLampOn.suggestBurn: If you wish to burn the %s, you should say so.

vLaunch.vehicle: You can't launch that by saying "launch"!

vLeap.actorTooBig: The %s is too big to jump over.
vLeap.goodTrick: That would be a good trick.
vLeap.unsafeJump: This was not a very safe place to try jumping.
vLeap.upATreeDaring: In a feat of unaccustomed daring, you manage to land on your feet without killing yourself.

vLookInside.doorOpen: The %s is open, but I can't tell what's beyond it.
vLookInside.nothingSpecialInside: There is nothing special to be seen.

vLookUnder.response: There is nothing but dust there.

vMelt.response: It's not clear that a %s can be melted.

preMove.holdingIt: You aren't an accomplished enough juggler.

vMumble.response: You'll have to speak up if you expect me to hear you!

preMung.bareHands: Trying to destroy the %s with your bare hands is futile.
preMung.withNonWeapon: Trying to destroy the %s with a %s is futile.

vOil.response: You probably put spinach in your gas tank, too.

vOpen.notOpenable: You must tell me how to do that to a %s.

vPourOn.waterSpills: The water spills over the %s, to the floor, and evaporates.

vPray.response: If you pray enough, your prayers may be answered.

vPushTo.response: You can't push things to that.

vPutBehind.response: That hiding place is too obvious.

vPutOn.noSurface: There's no good surface on the %s.

preRead.dark: It is impossible to read in the dark.
preRead.cantReadThroughOpaque: How does one look through a %s?

vRepent.response: It could very well be too late!

vReply.response: It is hardly likely that the %s is interested.

vRing.response: How, exactly, can you ring that?

vSay.talkingToSelf: Talking to yourself is a sign of impending mental collapse.

vSend.actor: Why would you send for the %s?

vShake.actor: This seems to have no effect.
vShake.cantTakeIt: You can't take it; thus, you can't shake it!
vShake.openContainerSpills: The contents of the %s spill to the ground.
vShake.soundsLikeSomethingInside: It sounds like there is something inside the %s.

vStab.noWeapon: No doubt you propose to stab the %s with your pinky?

vStand.alreadyStanding: You are already standing, I think.

vStay.response: You will be lost without me!

vStrike.actorNoWeapon: Since you aren't versed in hand-to-hand combat, you'd better attack the %s with a weapon.

vSwim.inDungeon: Swimming isn't usually allowed in the dungeon.

preTake.inClosedContainer: You can't reach something that's inside a closed container.

vTell.actorNoContinuation: The %s pauses for a moment, perhaps thinking that you should reread the manual.

vThrow.thrownAtSelf: A terrific throw! The %s hits you squarely in the head. Normally, this wouldn't do much damage, but by incredible mischance, you fall over backwards trying to duck, and break your neck, justice being swift and merciful in the Great Underground Empire.
vThrow.actorDucks: The %s ducks as the %s flies by and crashes to the ground.

vThrowOff.response: You can't throw anything off of that!

vTie.toSelf: You can't tie anything to yourself.
vTie.toOther: You can't tie the %s to that.

vTieUp.response: You could certainly never tie it with that!

vTurn.noInstrument: Your bare hands don't appear to be enough.

vUntie.response: This cannot be tied, so it cannot be untied!

vWalk.movedIntoDark: You have moved into a dark place.
vWalk.grueNoSpray: Oh, no! You have walked into the slavering fangs of a lurking grue!
vWalk.grueSpray: There are odd noises in the darkness, and there is no exit in that direction.

vWish.response: With luck, your wish will come true.

describeRoom.darkNoSpray: It is pitch black. You are likely to be eaten by a grue.
describeRoom.objectsDark: Only bats can see in the dark. And you're not one.

goto.cantGoInVehicle: You can't go there in a %s.
goto.cantGoWithoutVehicle: You can't go there without a vehicle.
goto.darkPlaceEntered: You have moved into a dark place.
goto.grueSlitherRoom: Oh, no! A lurking grue slithered into the room and devoured you!
goto.grueSlitherVehicle: Oh, no! A lurking grue slithered into the %s and devoured you!
goto.sinisterDark: There are sinister gurgling noises in the darkness all around you!

itake.deadHands: Your hand passes through its object.
itake.loadTooHeavyInjured: Your load is too heavy, especially in light of your condition.
itake.tooManyThings: You're holding too many things already!

scoreUpd.whisper: An almost inaudible voice whispers in your ear, "Look to your treasures for the final secret."

jigsUp.deserveAnotherChance:
Now, let's take a look here...
Well, you probably deserve another chance.  I can't quite fix you
up completely, but you can't have everything.
jigsUp.suicidalManiac:
You clearly are a suicidal maniac.  We don't allow psychotics in the
cave, since they may harm other adventurers.  Your remains will be
installed in the Land of the Living Dead, where your fellow
adventurers may gloat over them.
jigsUp.talented:
It takes a talented person to be killed while already dead. YOU are such
a talent. Unfortunately, it takes a talented person to deal with it.
I am not such a talent. Sorry.

yuks._source: gverbs.zil:2204-2211 (ITAKE non-takeable pick, V-TAKE via PICK-ONE)

entries: Nice weather we've been having lately.
You should have looked before you leaped.
In the movies, your life would be passing before your eyes.
Very good. Now you can go to the second grade.
Do you expect me to applaud?

parserMessages.oopsQuotedText: Sorry, you can't correct mistakes in quoted text.
parserMessages.oopsFirstWord: Warning: only the first word after OOPS is used.
parserMessages.oopsNoWord: There was no word to replace!
parserMessages.againRepeatMistake: That would just repeat a mistake.
parserMessages.tooManyNouns: There were too many nouns in that sentence.
parserMessages.cantUseWord: You used the word "%s" in a way that I don't understand.
parserMessages.noVerb: There was no verb in that sentence!
parserMessages.unrecognizedSentence: That sentence isn't one I recognize.
parserMessages.actorCantOrphan: "I don't understand! What are you referring to?"
parserMessages.multipleDirectObjects: You can't use multiple direct objects with "%s".
parserMessages.multipleIndirectObjects: You can't use multiple indirect objects with "%s".
parserMessages.nounMissing: There seems to be a noun missing in that sentence!
parserMessages.disambiguation: Which %s do you mean, the %s, or the %s?
parserMessages.dontSeeReferring: I don't see what you're referring to.
parserMessages.pleaseConsultManual: Please consult your manual for the correct way to talk to other people or creatures.
parserMessages.notClearReferring: It's not clear what you're referring to.
parserMessages.nothingHereToTake: There's nothing here you can take.
parserMessages.objectNotHereSingular: The object that you mentioned isn't here.
parserMessages.objectNotHerePlural: The objects that you mentioned aren't here.
parserMessages.otherObjectNotHereSingular: The other object that you mentioned isn't here.
parserMessages.otherObjectNotHerePlural: The other objects that you mentioned aren't here.
parserMessages.itNotAccessible: I don't see what you are referring to.
